title.en: Descript: Media Hours, AI Credits and Voice Consent
title.zh: Descript：媒体时长、AI Credits 与语音同意
title.cn: Descript：媒体时长、AI Credits 与语音同意

content.en: Consider Descript when transcript-led audio and video editing can replace part of a timeline workflow. Compare media hours and AI credits separately, then verify team cost, voice consent, data controls and the manual corrections your real project needs.
content.zh: 当文本式音视频编辑能替代部分时间线工作时，可考虑 Descript。应分别计算媒体时长与 AI credits，并核对团队成本、语音同意、数据控制和真实项目所需的人工修正。
content.cn: 当文本式音视频编辑能替代部分时间线工作时，可考虑 Descript。应分别计算媒体时长与 AI credits，并核对团队成本、语音同意、数据控制和真实项目所需的人工修正。

detail.en:
Choose Descript when the workflow begins with recorded speech and a transcript rather than a complex timeline. It combines recording, transcription, text-based audio and video editing, Underlord assistance, AI Speakers, dubbing, avatars and generated media in one workspace. Keep those capabilities under one Descript canonical page instead of treating feature names as separate products. [Pricing](https://www.descript.com/pricing) · [AI Speakers](https://help.descript.com/hc/en-us/articles/17372069745293-AI-Speakers-overview).

Pricing checked September 20, 2026: Free is USD 0 with one media hour per month and 100 AI credits granted one time. Hobbyist is USD 16 per person per month billed annually or USD 24 monthly, with 10 media hours and 400 monthly credits. Creator is USD 24 annually effective or USD 35 monthly, with 30 media hours, 800 credits, 4K export and top-ups. Business is USD 50 annually effective or USD 65 monthly, with 40 media hours, 1,500 credits, Brand Studio, translation and dubbing, custom avatars and priority support. Enterprise is custom. Prices are per person; annual-effective figures are not flexible monthly charges. [Current pricing](https://www.descript.com/pricing).

Budget two meters. Imported or recorded media consumes the Drive's media-minute pool, and unused media minutes do not roll over. AI actions consume a separate shared credit pool. Current examples vary from a few credits for an image to about 67 credits per avatar minute; dubbing, regeneration, video and model choice can change consumption. Eligible Editor seats add allowance to the shared Drive pool, so one user's activity can affect the team. Do not estimate a universal cost per finished video. [Usage and credits](https://help.descript.com/hc/en-us/articles/27841674958221-Track-and-understand-your-Media-minutes-and-AI-Credits).

Voice and avatar access requires a rights check. Descript requires an authorization statement for a custom AI Speaker and prohibits cloning a speaker who has not consented. It allows commercial use of an authorized personal clone and stock speakers, but its terms say AI output may be non-unique, inaccurate, unreliable or potentially infringing. Possessing a recording is not the same as having consent, and product permission is not a copyright or publicity-right guarantee. [Terms](https://www.descript.com/terms) · [Ethics](https://www.descript.com/ethics).

Data controls also have scope. Users can disable Share Data with Descript for product improvement, while project information is still processed to provide the service. AI Speaker training audio has separate de-identification, research and human-review disclosures. Enterprise controls such as custom retention, SSO, SCIM and audit logs are not defaults for every plan. Verify the actual workspace, contract and subprocessors. [Privacy](https://www.descript.com/privacy) · [Security](https://www.descript.com/security).

Independent evidence supports a real decision but not a universal result. G2 lists more than 900 reviews, while Trustpilot's materially lower rating includes support and credit complaints. Use a representative episode or video to measure import-to-export time, transcript corrections, audio repair, regeneration attempts, credit consumption, output quality and collaboration friction before moving a team. The De artwork on this page is an AI Best Tool editorial identifier, not Descript's official logo or a product screenshot.
detail.zh:
当工作从录音和转写文本开始，而不是从复杂时间线开始时，可以考虑 Descript。它把录制、转写、文本式音视频编辑、Underlord、AI Speakers、配音、avatars 和生成媒体放进同一 workspace。所有能力应保留在一个 Descript canonical 页面下，不能把功能名拆成独立工具。[价格](https://www.descript.com/pricing) · [AI Speakers](https://help.descript.com/hc/en-us/articles/17372069745293-AI-Speakers-overview)。

2026-09-20 价格核验：Free 为 0 美元，每月 1 个 media hour，另有一次性 100 AI credits。Hobbyist 年付折算每人每月 16 美元或月付 24 美元，含 10 media hours 与每月 400 credits。Creator 年付折算 24 美元或月付 35 美元，含 30 media hours、800 credits、4K 导出和 top-up。Business 年付折算 50 美元或月付 65 美元，含 40 media hours、1,500 credits、Brand Studio、翻译与配音、自定义 avatars 和优先支持。Enterprise 为定制。所有价格按人计算，年付折算价不是灵活月付价。[当前价格](https://www.descript.com/pricing)。

必须分别预算两个计量器。导入或录制媒体会消耗 Drive 的 media-minute 池，未用媒体分钟不会结转；AI 操作消耗另一套共享 credit 池。当前示例从每张图片数个 credits 到每分钟 avatar 约 67 credits，配音、重新生成、视频和模型选择都会改变消耗。符合条件的 Editor 席位向共享 Drive 池增加额度，因此一个成员的操作会影响团队余额。不能虚构统一的每条视频成本。[用量与 credits](https://help.descript.com/hc/en-us/articles/27841674958221-Track-and-understand-your-Media-minutes-and-AI-Credits)。

语音与 avatar 使用必须先检查权利。Descript 为自定义 AI Speaker 要求授权声明，并禁止克隆未同意的说话人。平台允许已授权的本人 clone 和 stock speaker 用于商业用途，但条款同时说明 AI 输出可能不唯一、不准确、不可靠或潜在侵权。拥有录音不等于取得同意，平台许可也不是版权或人格权保证。[条款](https://www.descript.com/terms) · [Ethics](https://www.descript.com/ethics)。

数据控制也有范围。用户可以关闭 Share Data with Descript 以停止用于产品改进，但项目信息仍需为提供服务而处理；AI Speaker 训练音频另有去标识研究和人工复核披露。自定义留存、SSO、SCIM 和 audit logs 等 Enterprise 控制不是所有套餐默认能力，应核对实际 workspace、合同和子处理商。[隐私](https://www.descript.com/privacy) · [安全](https://www.descript.com/security)。

独立证据说明这是一个真实选择，但不能证明所有场景效果。G2 有 900 多条评论，而 Trustpilot 明显更低的评分包含支持和 credits 方面的不满。迁移团队前，应使用代表性节目或视频测量从导入到导出的时间、转写修正、音频修复、重新生成次数、credit 消耗、输出质量和协作摩擦。页面 De 图形是 AI Best Tool 自制编辑识别图，不是 Descript 官方 Logo 或产品截图。
